metadata.description: CatalystNeuro skills for standardization and analysis of open neurophysiology data.

plugins.name: analyzing-dandi-datasets
plugins.description: Analyze neurophysiology datasets from the DANDI Archive. Load NWB files with streaming access, use Pynapple for data inspection, and create analysis pipelines for neural phenomena.

plugins.name: using-nemos
plugins.description: Fit Generalized Linear Models (GLMs) to neuroscience data using the NeMoS Python package. Covers basis functions, observation models, regularization, population GLMs, and cross-validation with scikit-learn.

plugins.name: using-pynapple
plugins.description: Analyze neurophysiology time series using the pynapple Python package. Covers core data structures, time series manipulation, metadata filtering, tuning curves, decoding, and signal processing.

plugins.name: nwb-convert
plugins.description: Convert neurophysiology data to NWB format and publish on DANDI. Guides through experiment discovery, data inspection, metadata collection, synchronization, code generation, testing, and upload. Generates a pip-installable conversion repo using NeuroConv and PyNWB.

plugins.name: spyglass-convert
plugins.description: Convert neurophysiology data to Spyglass-compatible NWB format and insert into a Spyglass (DataJoint) database, for ARC conversion projects. Guides through environment setup, Spyglass-compatible NWB conversion, session insertion, table verification, and a tutorial notebook.
